title: Chat: add activeCallId back-reference on Chat
description: VTCCall points to Chat via chatId but Chat has no field pointing back. Chat clients cannot show 'a call is active in this channel' without querying VTCCall/query with chatId filter. Add activeCallId (String|null, server-set) on Chat. Server sets it when a VTCCall with this chatId enters active state, clears it when the call ends. Enables O(1) 'join call' banner in chat UI like Slack Huddles.
close_reason: Added activeCallId (String|null, server-set) field to Chat, set when a bound VTCCall enters active state.
